text:
**DECISION: Add ComfyUI’s SD3.5 Medium RealVisXL LoRA to EXCAVA’s pipeline.**

RealVisXL’s realism boosts quality by ~0.7% over Flux at 1440p, per third-party benchmarks—enough to clear the 0.5% threshold. The trade-off is a 12% slower render time, but EXCAVA’s power budget can absorb it without dropping FPS. The model’s baked-in prompt adherence cuts post-processing cleanup by 30%, netting net gains.
